interface.name: zsingularity_process_manager_v1
interface.description: Lets the shell find the process behind a toplevel, so it can end an application that stopped responding without guessing from process names.

request.name: get_pid

description.summary: ask for the process of a toplevel

request.description: The compositor answers with a pid event for the toplevel.

event.name: pid
event.description: The process id and where it comes from. For native clients it is the peer of the Wayland connection. For X11 windows it is the _NET_WM_PID property set by the client, which the client may leave unset or set wrongly. Pid is zero and source is none when nothing is known, and never names the X server itself.
